title: Share Notes
lead: Send some of your notes to another person — or add notes someone sent you. Everything happens on your device; nothing is uploaded.
send_d: Pick notes from your backup and make a small file to send to someone.
recv_d: Got a shared file? Preview the notes and add them to your own backup.
send_s1: Open one of your JW Library backups (a .jwlibrary file).
send_s2: Tick the notes you want to share.
send_s3: Create the file and send it however you like — email, chat, AirDrop. The other person opens JW Sync → Share → Receive.
pick_help: Choose a .jwlibrary backup to pick notes from. It never leaves your device.
sel_help: Tap a note to tick it. Only the notes you tick are included.
no_sel: Tick at least one note first.
no_notes: No notes found in this backup.
made_h: Send this to the other person. They open JW Sync → Share → Receive, then choose this file.
cel_title: Your notes are packed and downloaded
cel_sub: Saved as {f}. Send it to the other person however you like — email, chat, AirDrop.
cel_s2: Chooses “Receive notes” and picks the file you sent.
cel_s3: Adds them to their own backup — their notes are never replaced.
cel_msg: Copy a message to send with it
cel_msg_body: I’m sending you {n} notes from my JW Library. Open {u}, choose “Receive notes”, and pick the file I sent — they will be added to your library without replacing anything you wrote.
recv_s1: Paste the shared text, or choose the .jwshare.json file you were sent.
recv_s2: Preview the notes to make sure they look right.
recv_s3: Add them into one of your own backups, then restore that backup to JW Library.
paste_ph: Paste shared notes here, or drop a .jwshare.json file…
invalid: That doesn’t look like a valid shared-notes file.
prev_h: These are read-only. To keep them, add them to one of your backups below.
add_h: Choose the .jwlibrary backup you want these notes added to. You’ll get an updated copy to download.
adopt_done_h: Download the updated backup, then restore it in JW Library to see the notes.
pm_safe: Added as new notes — your own notes are never replaced.
ov_q: {n} highlight(s) land on verses you already highlighted. How should we add them?
conf_intro: These notes are on verses you already highlighted:
more_hint: +{n} more — use the filters above to narrow
privacy: Private: this file is made on your device and only contains the notes you chose. Share it only with people you trust.
